v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Qui hábitas in cælis, * miserére nobis.
text.en: Thou who dwellest in heaven, * have mercy on us.
Our help is * in the name of the Lord.

text.la: In circúitu pópuli sui * Dóminus, ex hoc nunc et usque in sǽculum.
text.en: The Lord standeth round his people * from this time forth and for evermore.

text.la: Magnificávit Dóminus * fácere nobíscum: facti sumus lætántes.
text.en: The Lord hath * done great things for us, whereof we rejoice.

text.la: Dóminus ædíficet * nobis domum, et custódiat civitátem.
text.en: The Lord builds * the house and keeps the city.

text.la: Beátus vir, qui invéntus est sine mácula, et qui post aurum non ábiit, nec sperávit in pecúnia et thesáuris. Quis est hic, et laudábimus eum? fecit enim mirabília in vita sua.
text.en: Blessed is the rich man that is found without blemish: and that hath not gone after gold, nor put his trust in money nor in treasures. Who is he, and we will praise him? for he hath done wonderful things in his life.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: O Doctor óptime, * Ecclésiæ sanctæ lumen, beáte Antóni, divínæ legis amátor, deprecáre pro nobis Fílium Dei.
text.en: O right excellent Teacher * Light of the Holy Church, Anthony, blessed lover of the Divine Law, pray for us to the Son of God.

text.la: Ecclésiam tuam, Deus, beáti Antónii Confessóris tui atque Doctóris solémnitas votíva lætíficet: ut spirituálibus semper muniátur auxíliis et gáudiis pérfrui mereátur ætérnis.
text.en: O God, make thy Church to be glad at the solemn memorial of thy blessed Confessor and Doctor Anthony, causing her ever to be strong through thy ghostly succour, and fitting her to relish blessedness at thy right hand for evermore.

office.title: S. Antonii de Padua Confessoris et Ecclesiæ Doctoris
